- If you have a tracking number, copy it and paste it into the tracking portals of the carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL, etc.). Often, copying the tracking number into Google will give you a live map immediately.

**5. Contact Customer Support**
- If it's been longer than the estimated delivery date or you can't find your order number, check the retailer's "Contact Us" page and use their live chat or call their support line. Have your payment method's last 4 digits ready for verification.
